import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner s = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = s.nextInt();
        int b = s.nextInt();
        int[] arr = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            arr[i] = s.nextInt();
        }
        System.out.println(maxCuttings(arr, b));
    }

    private static int maxCuttings(int[] arr, int b) {
        var costs = new ArrayList<Integer>();
        int numEvens = arr[0] % 2 == 0 ? 1 : 0;
        int numOdds = arr[0] % 2 == 1 ? 1 : 0;
        int numCuttings = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i < arr.length; i++) {
            if (numOdds == numEvens&& Math.abs(arr[i]-arr[i-1])<=b) {
                numEvens = 0;
                numOdds = 0;
                costs.add(Math.abs(arr[i]-arr[i-1]));
            }
            if (arr[i] % 2 == 0) ++numEvens;
            else ++numOdds;
        }
        Collections.sort(costs);
        for(int i=0;i<costs.size();i++){
            if(b<costs.get(i))
                break;
            ++numCuttings;
            b-=costs.get(i);
        }
        return numCuttings;
    }
}

    private static int computeMaxCuttings(int[] arr, int b) {
        ArrayList<Integer> costs = new ArrayList<>();
        int numEvens = arr[0] % 2 == 0 ? 1 : 0;
        int numOdds = arr[0] % 2 == 1 ? 1 : 0;
        int numCuttings = 0;
        int i = 1;
        int p = 0;

        while (i <= arr.length - 1) {
            int diff = Math.abs(arr[i] - arr[p]);
            if (diff <= b && numOdds == numEvens) {
                costs.add(diff);
                numEvens = 0;
                numOdds = 0;
            }
            if (arr[i] % 2 == 0) numEvens++;
            else numOdds++;
            p = i++;
        }
        Collections.sort(costs);
        for (int j = 0; j < costs.size(); j++) {
            if (b < costs.get(j)) break;
            numCuttings++;
            b -= costs.get(j);
